Code implementation

Implemented, Partial, Missing and Unassessed are manual criterion-level source assessments.

Criterion totals come directly from those assessments. Story code status is derived: all criteria implemented → Implemented; all missing → Missing; mixed assessed states → Partial; all unassessed → Unassessed.

Verification proof

Focused, Native app / fixture and Live-model are separate proof channels.

Passed means a passing proof claim is recorded. No run recorded and Not assessed do not mean failed, and neither changes the code status. Task done records bounded task delivery, not story completion.
